note: Pinned by hand (tools/fetch-ort.js reads this). The three files below (the WebGPU/WebAssembly build: the loader, the WebAssembly module's factory and the module) are not in this repository: tools/fetch-ort.js takes them from this tarball (npm's registry), checks the tarball's integrity and each file's SHA-256, and puts them in lib/ort/ (ignored by git); tools/build.js adds them to every package. The whole runtime is in the package: nothing is loaded from the web when the extension runs.
